answer.reason: The same UTF-32 COMPOSE behavior is supported before and after g0002, but the fixed harness never enables COMPOSE in its direct UTF-32 calls. This is a preexisting coverage gap.
answer.finite_witness: Supply native-endian UTF-32 words [0x1100, 0x110000, 0x1161, 0x0000] as 16 bytes. The final byte is NUL, and the harness copies all four words. With COMPOSE, the out-of-range middle word must remain and prevent the Hangul pair from composing across it; none of the harness's direct calls enables that option.

scope_contract.reason: The entry directly normalizes fuzzer-controlled UTF-32 words. The source exposes COMPOSE for that operation and handles out-of-range words in its composition pass.

feasible_trigger.reason: A 16-byte, NUL-ending input passes the entry guards and supplies the four stated UTF-32 words. The source's Hangul composition case shows that 0x1100 and 0x1161 are composable when adjacent; 0x110000 triggers the intervening out-of-range guard.

observable_consequence.reason: With COMPOSE, the source passes the out-of-range word through and clears composition state, preventing composition across it. The harness's fixed direct-call options make this specific supported behavior unreachable.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: All direct UTF-32 calls omit COMPOSE. The NFC and UTF-8 mapping routes can use COMPOSE, but their UTF-8 decoder cannot supply 0x110000, and decomposition rejects an out-of-range codepoint. They therefore cannot exercise the same tuple.

identity_preserved.reason: Both versions support the same tuple: COMPOSE normalization of UTF-32 with an out-of-range separator. The old harness has the same missing option on both sides, so the blocker is preexisting.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With COMPOSE, utf8proc_normalize_utf32 preserves an out-of-range UTF-32 word and resets composition state so surrounding composable words remain separate.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness copies fuzzer bytes into UTF-32 words, then calls utf8proc_normalize_utf32 six times with fixed options that all omit UTF8PROC_COMPOSE.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Composition handling with an out-of-range UTF-32 separator cannot be reached through any direct call.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: NFC and UTF-8 mapping use UTF-8 input; decoding and decomposition cannot carry 0x110000 to the same normalization behavior.

The finite input meets the entry's size and final-NUL requirements.
The entry copies the supplied words into its normalization buffer.

The complete call sequence shows the direct options and the alternate UTF-8 routes.
Decomposition rejects 0x110000 if it is supplied by a route other than UTF-8 decoding.
